acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for installing a heated towel rack in a luxury bathroom varies based on several factors, including the type of rack (e.g., electric, hydronic), its size, material, and whether it's hardwired or plug-in. Integration into an existing electrical system during a remodel can influence complexity.
